botcomponent.description: Use when a new email arrives in the team's shared inbox and asks one or more questions. Research each question strictly against the agent's configured knowledge sources and return structured output to the workflow: EmailReply (a professional HTML reply body) and ReplyNeeded (whether a reply is warranted). The workflow replies to the triggering message with EmailReply only when ReplyNeeded is true. Set ReplyNeeded to false for emails containing no question. Do not answer from general or outside knowledge when the configured knowledge sources do not cover the topic.
botcomponent.name: email-question-research-reply
